clue.text: Mergenthaler's kind of floor covering?

explanation.walkthrough: Split as LINO TYPE it is a sort of floor covering; whole, it is the typesetting machine Mergenthaler patented in 1884. Lino is short for linoleum.
explanation.definitionFit: Mergenthaler invented the line-casting typesetting machine used by newspapers for decades, so it is literally his kind of machine.
